items.title: Safety Response Operations Lead
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM At OpenAI, our Trust, Safety & Risk Operations teams safeguard our products, users, and the company from abuse, fraud, scams, regulatory non-compliance, and other emerging risks. We operate at the intersection of operations, compliance, user trust, and safety working closely with Legal, Policy, Engineering, Product, Go-To-Market, and external partners to ensure our platforms are safe, compliant, and trusted by a diverse, global user base. The Global Safety Response Operations team provides 24/7 coverage for user safety, risk, and regulatory escalations across OpenAI’s products, handling the highest-priority cases that require human judgment and rapid response. The team operates as the core escalation and delivery arm of OpenAI’s safety operations, ensuring that our products remain safe and aligned with policy while enabling timely, empathetic, and consistent user support. ABOUT THE ROLE The Global Safety Response Operations Lead is a hands-on team lead who both manages a regional Safety Response team and personally handles high-risk safety cases. This role combines frontline safety work with people leadership, operational ownership, and cross-functional coordination. You will lead a team of Safety Response Analysts who handle OpenAI’s most sensitive and high-impact cases, while also personally contributing to casework for complex, high-risk, or high-visibility issues. You will own the execution of high severity escalations in your region and ensure proper execution and communication to cross functional stakeholders You will be accountable for ensuring your region consistently meets utilization, quality, and SLA targets while serving as the operational interface with Product, Policy, Legal, Investigations, and regional stakeholders. This is a 24/7 global operation that requires flexibility to support rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a leadership on-call model. In This Role, You Will: - Lead and coach a regional team of Safety Response Analysts, ensuring high performance, engagement, and consistent decision quality. - Own regional operational outcomes, including utilization, SLA adherence, backlog health, and quality benchmarks. - Handle and oversee the most complex and high-risk cases, serving as the first line of escalation and incident lead for your region. - Contribute directly to frontline work (20–30%), including investigations, enforcement decisions, and regulatory or legal escalations. - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Policy, Legal, Investigations, and local market teams to execute safety outcomes and manage risk. - Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement, improving workflows, tools, automation, and escalation paths. - Identify emerging risks and trends, translating frontline insights into actionable recommendations for policy, product, or enforcement. You Might Thrive in This Role If You: - You have 8+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Risk Operations, Investigations, Fraud, Annotation, or platform integrity. - You have 4+ years of direct people leadership or senior-level operational ownership, including coaching experienced operators, setting clear direction and supporting independent judgement. - You have applied AI tools and automation to improve operational workflows, with sound judgment about where human review remains essential. - You are deeply familiar with trust and safety operations, across multiple risk areas including content moderation, user safety, fraud, or developer risk frameworks, including the legal, policy, and technical considerations that shape enforcement. - You are a strong decision-maker in ambiguous, high-risk environments, able to balance speed, accuracy, and defensibility when handling sensitive or high-impact cases. - You communicate complex safety and risk decisions clearly and credibly, whether writing escalation narratives, briefing Legal or Policy, or aligning Product and leadership during incidents. - You can translate between frontline operations and strategic stakeholders, turning messy real-world cases into structured insights and turning policy or product direction into clear, executable guidance for your team. - You are skilled at influencing without authority, building trust with Product, Policy, Legal, Investigations, and regional partners to drive alignment and resolve ambiguity. - You use data, tooling, and automation to improve quality, efficiency, and scale to not just measure performance, but to make better decisions. - You are comfortable leading in a 24/7, high-pressure operational environment, providing calm, credible leadership during incidents, spikes, and regulatory or reputational events. items.description: The Technical Integration Manager leads technical integration projects for operators and partners, acting as the primary technical point of contact throughout the onboarding and delivery process. This role is responsible for driving project execution, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring successful, high-quality integrations. The position operates with independence and is expected to manage defined project scope while escalating complex risks or strategic decisions when necessary. Responsibilities Lead and manage technical integration projects with direct impact on operators and partners. Define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and dependencies in alignment with stakeholders. Assemble and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Track project deliverables and progress using appropriate tools. Drive project execution and ensure accountability across all involved parties. Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to stakeholders. Identify risks, issues, and blockers, and manage or escalate them as appropriate. Implement and manage project changes to achieve desired outcomes. Present project status, risks, and solutions clearly to stakeholders. Act as the primary technical point of contact for operators/partners during onboarding and integration. Support and execute system integrations involving APIs, platforms, and configurations. Collaborate with internal teams to gather and analyze technical and business requirements. Perform first-level troubleshooting of technical issues related to integrations. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve technical challenges efficiently. Maintain strong technical knowledge of products and integration processes. Maintain close collaboration with internal stakeholders across departments. Manage communication with external partners throughout integration projects. Align stakeholders on timelines, deliverables, and expectations. Provide clear, timely, and accurate updates on project status and issues. Represent the company professionally in all external interactions. Participate in testing and implementation of integration solutions in accordance with company procedures. Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and compliance requirements. Support monitoring of integration performance and stability. Prepare and maintain documentation of products, processes, and integration procedures. Follow established processes and best practices for integrations. Identify and suggest improvements to existing processes and workflows. Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and product updates. Maintain awareness of system ownership across the organization for efficient issue escalation. Maintain technical relationships with assigned operators/partners.
